content.text: {"label":"marketing_campaign","explanation":"General volume is +52% at 11:00 (143 vs 85 forecast) and rose from 10:45, about 30 minutes after a 700,000-recipient home-loan balance-transfer SMS (MKT-2026-825) went out at 10:15 saying 'Call us today to switch'. In general, loan_enquiry calls are at 2.02x normal, the largest excess, with account_update (1.42x) and balance_enquiry (1.28x) also up. Supply is not the cause: general had 37 of 39 planned agents and normal absences, and AHT is below forecast. The only open-looking incident is a resolved overnight batch. Payments is on forecast, but its service level dipped to 70.5% at 11:00, so it cannot safely donate agents.","plan_name":"General queue campaign surge: add capacity and soften peak","rationale":"The SMS will keep driving extra general calls through midday and into the afternoon. Moving cross-skilled agents from payments is ruled out because payments is at the 70% donor floor. The plan uses the cheapest levers first. Delaying general breaks is free and borrows capacity for the peak. Cancelling non-mandatory general coaching costs Rs 150 per session hour. Two consecutive overtime offers cover 11:45 to 15:45, with 10 agents offered each; at about 40% acceptance that is about 4 agents x 4 h x Rs 360, roughly Rs 5,760, well within the Rs 15,000 budget. The IVR callback offer moves long-wait callers to later, quieter periods.
